entities.name: Duncan Dokiwari

entities.summary: Duncan Dalnajeneso Danagogo Dokiwari is a Nigerian former professional boxer who competed from 1997 to 2006. As an amateur, he won a men's super heavyweight bronze medal at the 1996 Summer Olympics.
